summary:
Implemented TimeElapsedColumn and the related changes; nothing was run, so all test results are unverified.

Changes:
- rich/progress.py: TimeElapsedColumn (after BarColumn, before TimeRemainingColumn); Task.finished_time field (after _get_time, before visible); Task.finished now means finished_time is not None; Task._reset clears finished_time; Progress.update and advance capture elapsed as the last step inside the lock when completed >= total and no finished time is set; Progress.reset clears finished_time before refresh.
- rich/default_styles.py: "progress.elapsed" styled yellow.
- rich/palette.py: Palette.__rich__ with lazy imports and a TYPE_CHECKING import for Table; RGB cell is str(tuple(triplet)).
- CHANGELOG.md: Unreleased / Added entry for Progress.TimeElapsedColumn.
- tests/test_palette.py (new): test_rich_cast.
- tests/test_progress.py: TimeElapsedColumn import; new test_time_elapsed_column; TimeElapsedColumn added to test_columns after TimeRemainingColumn; test_columns expected output regenerated by hand trace of clock reads (not run).

Verification done by search only: 12 elapsed cells (one per rendered row); bar runs of 25 (unfinished) and 16 (finished) glyphs.

Not verified: no test was run. test_columns expected output is a hand trace and may be wrong in clock or padding details. I also reasoned, without running, that test_track, test_progress_track, and test_render are unaffected.

No commits were made.
